title: Transcriptional activation of plant immunity by salicylic acid.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC has no full text, supplement or text-mined accessions (no PMCID, paywalled). PDB full-text search for 'NPR1 MED15A' returned one entry, 9ZJN: cryo-EM (electron cryo-microscopy) structure of the Arabidopsis salicylic acid-bound NPR1-MED15 complex, 3.2 Å, released 2026-07-29; I read its metadata only. PDBe DOI search returned 0 entries; PRIDE (proteomics archive) keyword search for NPR1 salicylic returned 0 projects.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the experiments (proxiome mass spectrometry, AlphaFold interaction screens, HDX-MS hydrogen-deuterium exchange, binding affinities, NIMIN1 competition) comes from the abstract only; no data tables were seen.

a1_downloadable.note: The one deposited structure (PDB 9ZJN) is open; other datasets (proxiome, HDX-MS) were not found in PRIDE and the supplement is not retrievable (paywalled, no PMCID).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists: the outputs are one cryo-EM structure, a handful of binding measurements and HDX-MS (hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry) uptake curves for a few protein constructs. Any ML label would have to be constructed. Checked by repository search, not by opening files.

a3_inputs_present.note: No feature table; inputs would be a few protein sequences/structures.

a4_units_stated.note: No tabular measurements seen to check units.

a5_enough_rows.note: A mechanistic study of one receptor complex (NPR1 with MED15A and NIMIN1); the number of measured items is plausibly tens, far below 400. Exact count not verified.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: One PDB entry, a few MB

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts to compare; no data table retrieved.

a8_label_provenance.note: Measurements are physical (cryo-EM, binding assays, HDX-MS), but there is no label set to model.

backbone.name: ESM-2, a protein language model (would only apply to a protein-interaction framing)

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: None: one protein complex does not give a dataset that a join would enlarge.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper resolves the mechanism of one hormone receptor complex with a single structure and a few biochemical assays.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequence pairs to predict which plant immune receptor partners bind in a hormone-dependent way.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many protein pairs with measured binding with and without salicylic acid; this paper provides only a few (count unknown, supplement not retrieved).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a pair binds and whether salicylic acid strengthens it, from the paper's binding assays; too few examples exist.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant immunity researchers would gain a screen for hormone-gated interactions, but this paper cannot supply the training data.

ml_idea: None viable: a structural/biochemical mechanism paper on a single receptor complex (NPR1 with MED15A and NIMIN1) with one PDB entry (9ZJN) and no labelled table.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no modelling task exists.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count labelled items in the supplement: expected tens at most, already a killer.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic structural study of one receptor complex: one cryo-EM structure (PDB 9ZJN) and a few binding assays, no labelled table, far too few items (A2, A5).
